sn54.20:1.1: See [sn48.64]() and notes. I believe this opening fragment is a separate discourse, and what follows is a distinct discourse combining the items of [sn54.17]()–20.
sn54.20:1.2: Unlike [sn48.64:2.1](), the text does not coherently present a complete separate Sutta. Nonetheless, I believe this is due to faulty editing. This should start with, “Mendicants, when immersion due to mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated …”, but this is not found in any edition I have seen.
